_meta.notes: Owned by readyup-playersettings (plugins/playersettings): client cvar queries. Everything lives in libengine2.so and is checked at runtime through RTTI (and offline by CI with --lib engine2). The plugin builds a CNetMessagePB<58, CSVCMsg_GetCvarValue> itself (its vtable from the RTTI entry) and sends it with the client's own CServerSideClient::SendNetMessage, as the SDK's CNetMessage::Send does: the client comes from NetworkServerService_001 -> GetNetworkServer -> its client vector, found by scanning the server object for a vector of verified CServerSideClient pointers. The answer arrives in a hook on CServerSideClient::ProcessRespondCvarValue. The ByteSizeLong and CNetMessagePB entries are never called through a real object: their anchors pin the protobuf layout the plugin writes and reads (cvar_msg.h). CServerSideClient slot numbers are the SDK's + 1 (CUtlSlot's own virtual comes first). If any entry fails, only this plugin turns off.

CCLCMsg_RespondCvarValue::ByteSizeLong.note: Pins the answer's layout: has-bits at +0x10; bit 1 name (+0x18), bit 2 value (+0x20), bit 4 cookie (+0x28), bit 8 status_code (+0x2c). Which string is which comes from the parser (tag 0x1a -> +0x18, 0x22 -> +0x20, 0x08 -> +0x28, 0x10 -> +0x2c).

CNetMessagePB<GetCvarValue>::GetSerializ.note: INetworkSerializerPB* GetSerializerPB(): the message type PostEventAbstract wants. Slot 6 GetMessageId returns 58 (svc_GetCvarValue); slots 2 and 3 return this+0x30 (the protobuf part).

CNetMessagePB<RespondCvarValue>::AsMessa.note: The answer's protobuf part is at +0x30 (cvar_msg.h kProtoAt). Slot 6 GetMessageId returns 25 (clc_RespondCvarValue).

CSVCMsg_GetCvarValue::ByteSizeLong.note: Pins the query's layout: has-bits at +0x10, bit 1 the cvar_name string at +0x18, bit 2 the int32 cookie at +0x20.

CServerSideClient::ProcessRespondCvarVal.note: bool ProcessRespondCvarValue(const CCLCMsg_RespondCvarValue_t&): a `return true` stub in CS2, hooked for the answers. Its neighbours tie the index down: slot 35 is ProcessCmdKeyValues, slot 41 ProcessPacketStart (not a stub).

CServerSideClient::SendNetMessage.note: bool SendNetMessage(const CNetMessage*, NetChannelBufType_t): what the SDK's CNetMessage::Send calls per client. A helper it calls logs "NetMessage %s"; slot 35 is ProcessCmdKeyValues.

INetworkServerService::GetNetworkServer.note: CNetworkGameServer* GetNetworkServer(): 11 IAppSystem + 11 IEngineService slots + its two destructors. Slot 12 is IEngineService::GetName (mov rax, [rdi+0x28]), slot 20 GetServiceIndex (movzx eax, word [rdi+0x32]).
